name: comp-388
blurb: Compact popover form for collecting user feedback.
description: A shadcn Popover with a textarea for feedback and a send button; appears inline without interrupting the workflow.
use_when: Collecting quick feedback on a page without opening a full modal.
avoid_when: When feedback requires multiple fields or detailed explanations — the popover is intentionally minimal.
a11y: Textarea has aria-label; send button is accessible; popover has proper semantics; full keyboard navigation.
